name: dsh-headless-json
description: Structured, machine-readable CI output for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): session event capture with JSON/NDJSON reports, JUnit XML, semantic exit codes, artifact collection and privacy redaction. Ships as a dsh profile bundle and a standalone CLI.
